function: UE-side learned binary decision whether to feed back CSI (self-nomination) to cut CSI feedback in MU-MIMO downlink, trained with scheduling and ZF in the loop (p. 1, 3).
system: MU-MISO downlink, BS with 1x32 ULA or 4x8 UPA, single-antenna UEs, narrowband, 7 GHz (FR3), single cell of 100 m radius, no RIS (p. 3, 9).
method: DNN (1D conv plus FC, sigmoid, hard threshold) trained unsupervised with primal-dual Lagrangian, by straight-through gradients or by policy gradient; also few-shot fine-tuning (p. 4-7, 14).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa simulator with 3GPP TR 38.901 UMi at 7 GHz: 100,000 UE channels, 60,000 sets for training and 10,000 for testing; RMa for transfer test (p. 9, 14).
test_conditions: Separate DNN per array, M, NFB and number of UEs, tested on held-out UMi sets; UMi-ULA model tested zero-shot and with 10% fine-tuning on RMa-UPA (p. 9, 14).
baselines: Non-learned: all-UE feedback, random feedback (p=0.5), limited all feedback, with random, opportunistic and SUS scheduling, ZF and RZF; no earlier learned method (p. 9-11).
metrics: Downlink sum-rate (bps/Hz), average number of feedback UEs (up to 65% reduction), mean log utility and CDF of mean rate under PF, condition number (p. 10-13).
q1_support: p. 9: "QuaDRiGa simulator [38], beginning with 100,000 UE channel realizations derived from the 3GPP 38.901 UMi model [39]"; Table I also lists "UMi in TR 38.901".
q2_support: p. 14: "pretrained on the 3GPP UMi scenario with a ULA configuration and subsequently evaluated on the rural-macrocell (RMa) scenario with a UPA configuration", zero-shot and few-shot with 10% of the target data.
q3_support: p. 9: "two baselines: 'All FB,' where every user feeds back its CSI, and 'Random FB,'" plus RS, OS and SUS scheduling, all non-learned. Missing: an earlier learned method; DO and PG are two trainings of the same network (p. 2) and the CQI-only DNN is an input variant (p. 10).
q4_support: p. 5: "one-dimensional (1D) convolutional layers first extract spatial-frequency features, followed by FC layers"; no operation count, parameter count or runtime is given, only the qualitative p. 3 remark "excessive computational overhead" about exhaustive scheduling.
q5_support: p. 9: "The simulation datasets are generated using the QuaDRiGa simulator [38]"; the data are generated by the authors and the paper gives no link or DOI for its code or data.
notes: Included as area 2 (CSI feedback reduction). Borderline: the learned decision selects which UEs report CSI, which a reviewer could read as user selection above the physical layer; kept as feedback because the DNN decides the CSI report (p. 1) and is trained with the ZF sum-rate in the loop (p. 4-5), while BS scheduling and ZF are not learned. q3 = 0 because the direct-optimization method is 'adapted from our prior conference work' (p. 2) but is presented as one of the two proposed trainings of the same network (p. 10: 'both proposed self-nomination methods'), never as a baseline; if the reviewer counts it as an earlier learned method, q3 would be 1. The DOI printed on p. 1 reads 10.1109/TWC.2025.3651229, so the year differs from the list DOI while the number matches.
